newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai taxes from foreigners surge in 1992-1996.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai taxes from foreigners surge in 1992-1996.

text.p: Taxes received from foreigners and foreign companies in Shanghai soared by more than six times between 1992 and 1996 to 17.892 billion yuan ($2.16 billion) by the end of last year, Xinmin Evening News said on Wednesday.
Turnover of foreign-funded companies in Shanghai was 200 billion yuan in 1996, the newspaper said.
Turnover of foreign manufacturing firms was 172 billion yuan, accounting for 30 percent of the city's total output value, it said.
Foreign companies' exports were valued at $4.2 billion in 1996, accounting for 30 percent of Shanghai's total export turnover, it said but gave no further details.
